250:     /// Only local owner/DB/history failures stop pinned polling. A peer's signed
251:     /// refusal is still a remote observation, even if it names a structural code.
252:     /// Original owner ancestry budgets retain their fatal policy. The specific
253:     /// cumulative public History request budget has a private nonfatal origin;
254:     /// a later local-integrity classification still overrides that origin.
255:     /// Capacity alone never authorizes a retry.
256:     pub fn requires_owner_stop(&self) -> bool {
257:         if self.request_history_budget && self.kind == ErrorKind::Capacity {
258:             return false;
259:         }
260:         if self.kind == ErrorKind::RemoteRefusal {
261:             return false;
262:         }
263:         self.kind == ErrorKind::LocalStructure
264:             || matches!(
265:                 self.code,
266:                 Some(
267:                     ErrorCode::NamespaceChanged
268:                         | ErrorCode::DatabaseReplaced
269:                         | ErrorCode::OwnerReplaced
270:                         | ErrorCode::AncestryIndexBudget
271:                         // The original paid CPU owner becoming unavailable is
272:                         // NOT a transient remote peer refusal or budget debit.
273:                         // A pinned poller must stop instead of silently trying
274:                         // fresh unowned work in its next cycle.
275:                         | ErrorCode::PublicMutationCpuUnavailable
276:                         | ErrorCode::OwnerPublicServiceCpuDomain
277:                         | ErrorCode::OwnerPublicServiceDomainUnbound
278:                         | ErrorCode::OwnerReorgTerminationCpuRequired
279:                         | ErrorCode::OwnerPublicServiceUncleanEpoch
280:                         | ErrorCode::OwnerDetachedExecutionUnsupported
281:                         | ErrorCode::OwnerContinuousHistoryDurableRequired
282:                 )
283:             )
284:     }
